# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.

completion:
Perform a database query to pinpoint the exact building with issues in the past year.
3. Visit the location in person and assess its compliance with safety standards.
4. Document any violations and note if they are recurring.
5. Summarize findings and update the inspection records with the new information to ensure they reflect the current status.
